claims.quote: Evidence exists that gold sequins were being used as decoration on clothing or paraphernalia in the Indus Valley as early as 2500 BC, during the Kot Diji phase.
claims.note: earliest gold sequins in Indus Valley

claims.quote: The name sequin originates from the Venetian colloquial noun zechin (Venetian: [(d)zeˈkiŋ]), meaning a Venetian ducat coin, rendered into French as sequin (French: [səkɛ̃]).
claims.note: name came from the Venetian ducat coin
